description: Defines the QuicServerSessionBase class, a server-specific subclass of QuicSpdySession, including methods for managing QUIC server sessions, crypto streams, bandwidth estimation, and connection handling.

classes.name: QuicServerSessionBase
classes.description: A server-specific subclass of QuicSpdySession managing QUIC server session behaviors, including crypto streams, bandwidth estimation, and connection lifecycle.

methods.name: QuicServerSessionBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing the server session with configuration, connection, and crypto settings.

methods.name: OnConnectionClosed
methods.description: Handles connection closure, overriding base behavior.

methods.name: OnBandwidthUpdateTimeout
methods.description: Overrides to send bandwidth estimate updates.

methods.name: OnCongestionWindowChange
methods.description: Sends server config update with new bandwidth estimate.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the session.

methods.name: crypto_stream
methods.description: Returns the current crypto stream.

methods.name: OnConfigNegotiated
methods.description: Processes bandwidth-related config received from client.

methods.name: set_serving_region
methods.description: Sets the server's serving region string.

methods.name: serving_region
methods.description: Returns the server's serving region string.

methods.name: GetSSLConfig
methods.description: Retrieves SSL configuration.

methods.name: enable_sending_bandwidth_estimate_when_network_idle
methods.description: Checks if bandwidth estimate is sent when network is idle.

methods.name: GetMutableCryptoStream
methods.description: Returns mutable crypto stream.

methods.name: GetCryptoStream
methods.description: Returns crypto stream.

methods.name: GenerateCachedNetworkParameters
methods.description: Generates cached network parameters.

methods.name: ShouldCreateOutgoingBidirectionalStream
methods.description: Determines if outgoing bidirectional stream can be created.

methods.name: ShouldCreateOutgoingUnidirectionalStream
methods.description: Determines if outgoing unidirectional stream can be created.

methods.name: ShouldCreateIncomingStream
methods.description: Determines if incoming stream can be created.

methods.name: CreateQuicCryptoServerStream
methods.description: Creates a new crypto server stream (abstract method).

methods.name: crypto_config
methods.description: Returns the crypto configuration.

methods.name: stream_helper
methods.description: Returns the helper for creating crypto streams.

methods.name: SendSettingsToCryptoStream
methods.description: Informs crypto stream of SETTINGS for the connection.

methods.name: BandwidthToCachedParameterBytesPerSecond
methods.description: Converts bandwidth to cached network parameter units.
